scenarios.prompt: 상품 가격 옵션은 고객과 운영자가 새 상품을 저장하거나 기존 상품을 수정·복사하거나, 고객·운영자·카탈로그의 일괄 가져오기 또는 백업 복원을 할 때 모두 같은 규칙을 따라야 합니다. 상품마다 가격 옵션은 1개에서 10개까지 허용하고, 각 수량은 정수 1~999이며 한 상품 안에서 중복될 수 없고 모든 옵션은 같은 판매 단위를 사용해야 합니다. 999와 10개는 허용하고 1000, 중복 수량, 단위가 섞인 옵션, 11개 옵션은 자르거나 일부만 저장하지 말고 거절해 주세요. 직접 저장이 거절되면 HTTP 400 validation_failed를 반환하고 상품·옵션·버전을 그대로 둡니다. 고객 일괄 가져오기는 잘못된 행을 invalid로 세고 그 상품을 바꾸지 않으며, 다른 유효한 행은 계속 저장합니다. 운영자 미리보기는 잘못된 행이 있으면 conflict로 표시하고 invalidRows에 포함하며, 그 작업의 적용은 거절해야 합니다. 카탈로그 가져오기도 잘못된 옵션을 저장하지 않습니다. 백업 복원 미리보기는 적용 불가로 표시하고, 적용은 HTTP 409 backup_conflict로 거절하며 데이터를 바꾸지 않습니다. 정상 복사와 모든 정상 저장 후에는 입력한 옵션 전체가 같은 순서와 가격으로 남아야 합니다.

scenarios.prompt: The public customer action `compare-cart-item` adds a cart product to comparison from that item's cart row. Provide that action on every cart row. The comparison list holds at most five products: adding a fifth succeeds, and trying to add a sixth leaves all current session content unchanged. Repeating the action for a product already in comparison also leaves all current session content unchanged; the product must not be removed or duplicated. Only a known product with a positive quantity in the cart may be added. If the product is unknown, absent from the cart, or has quantity zero, leave all current session content unchanged. On success, append the new product after the existing comparison products without changing their order. Keep the cart and its quantities, and keep every existing comparison product's selection, quantity, pharmacist confirmation, and review information. The new product starts unselected, with any old selection quantity and review or confirmation information for that product cleared. After a successful addition, clear the selected tester and reset purchase-request and purchase-completed status. All other session information remains unchanged on success. For every rejected request, preserve all current content, including tester selection and purchase status.

scenarios.prompt: Tylenol 500 is a medicine, and every other product marked as a medicine must receive the same safeguards. Keep a medicine product overview hidden until a pharmacist confirms it, and do not accept a purchase request for a medicine until that confirmation is recorded. After confirmation, accept the request only when the price is known, the item is in stock, its package is confirmed, and no other store review is pending. A cosmetic may show its overview and may have a purchase request accepted without pharmacist confirmation when its price, stock, and package requirements are satisfied. If a cosmetic independently needs pharmacist review, wait for that review too. Apply these rules both when a customer views a product overview and when they submit a purchase request; ordinary cosmetics must not be blocked by the medicine safeguard.
